# Acme Widget

> Full documentation bundle for agents. Everything below is plain Markdown.

## Overview

Acme Widget formats widget manifests. It validates fields, normalizes
ordering and prints a canonical form.

## Install

```sh
npm install -g acme-widget
```

## Commands

- `acme-widget format <file>` writes the canonical manifest.
- `acme-widget validate <file>` checks fields and exits nonzero on errors.

## Reference

- [Capabilities](https://widget.example.com/capabilities.json)
- [MCP entry](https://widget.example.com/server.json)
- [Sitemap](https://widget.example.com/sitemap.xml)
